parts.tooltip: A shared mutable cell, accessed only through STM operations.
readTVar :: TVar a ⟶ STM a — read the cell value inside a transaction.
A value to be written tentatively inside the transaction.
writeTVar :: TVar a ⟶ a ⟶ STM () — record a tentative write.
The transactional program composes reads and writes before it is run.
atomically :: STM a ⟶ IO a — commit all writes together or retry the whole transaction.
The result is available in IO only after the transaction commits.
